title: Achieve playable browser vision
description: Current playtest at http://localhost:5174/ can advance, acknowledge interrupts, reset, copy packets, and autosave, but it stalls after consuming the seeded order queue because the player cannot issue new orders. Finish the next slice by exposing browser order commands, adding order-entry controls, adding manual save/load UI, and surfacing a debrief/outcome flow that reaches the intended Remote Ops vertical-slice vision.

title: Close board tooltips on pointer leave
description: Board tooltips should close as soon as the pointer leaves the tile or robot that triggered them. Fix the hover/leave handling so stale tooltip cards do not linger after the cursor moves away.

title: Move Settings tab to the end
description: Reorder the sidebar tabs so the navigation reads Mission, Mission Feed, Settings instead of putting Settings in the middle.

title: Clarify browser order rejection messages
description: The current browser-shell order rejection text is too raw and confusing, especially for move targets that reference coordinates not on the facility map. Make the in-app status clearer and more player-facing.

title: Trim mission layout spacing
description: Reduce the browser shell padding another small step and tighten the main board/sidebar column gap to roughly 4px so Mission and Settings feel less floaty.
notes: Keep the slightly tighter padding, but restore the main board/sidebar gap after the 4px experiment felt too cramped. Advance/Acknowledge also moved back into Mission while Reset stays in Settings.

title: Move shell controls into Settings tab
description: Rename the Canonical Save sidebar tab to Settings and place the shell controls panel inside that tab so shell-level actions and save/restore live together instead of crowding Mission.

title: Add in-app quickstart guidance
description: Players do not yet understand how to play the current prototype. Add concise stage-aware onboarding inside the browser shell so the contract, briefing, mission, and order/advance loop are self-explanatory.

title: Tighten browser shell spacing
description: Overall UI spacing in the browser shell feels too loose. Reduce shared padding and gaps across shell layout, panels, cards, buttons, forms, and supporting UI so the interface reads denser while staying legible.
notes: Expanded scope: reduce scroll fatigue by adding top sidebar tabs. Default tab should be Mission, with Canonical Save and Mission Feed as separate tabs.

title: Make the tactical board clickable
description:
Why: the tactical board currently supports hover intel, but mission interaction still happens mostly through detached form controls. That makes the board feel passive even though it is the primary tactical surface.

What: make clicking board robots and tiles drive contextual mission actions from the board itself. Clicking a robot or tile should surface the relevant actions the browser shell can perform for that target, prefill mission order state, and let the operator queue actions without manually reconstructing the context elsewhere in the UI.

Done when: the live mission board supports click selection for robots and key tiles, shows contextual actions for the selected target, and those actions correctly queue deterministic browser orders without regressing the existing mission shell.

title: Add board item hover tooltips
description:
Why: the board currently exposes hover/focus detail only for robot markers, which makes other tactical board items feel dead and harder to read.

What: extend the existing board tooltip UX so hovering or focusing meaningful board items (tiles and board markers) surfaces their tactical context using the same visual language as the robot overlay.

Done when: the live board shows tooltips for meaningful non-robot items without regressing robot hover behavior or keyboard accessibility.

title: Add contract lobby and mission config flow
description: The browser shell currently drops directly into the mission. Add a staged pre-mission flow with contract selection first, then a modest mission config step, then mission launch. Include multiple contract options and coherent autosave/resume behavior so the first-run experience feels like choosing an operation instead of being thrown straight into it.

title: Improve tactical board readability and hover details
description: The tactical board is too flat visually and robot markers do not reveal details on hover. Improve tile differentiation by tile kind/purpose and add hover/focus robot detail affordances so the board reads better without relying entirely on the side roster.

title: Silence Vite warnings for Sigil-generated imports
description: Vite dev emits dynamic import analysis warnings for copied Sigil-generated .mjs files because they use import(modulePath). Adjust the web generation flow so generated modules are Vite-friendly and the dev server starts cleanly.

title: Build browser order controls UI
description: Why: the browser shell can advance, acknowledge, reset, and save, but still cannot queue high-level robot orders through the existing gameApi order API.\n\nWhat: add a modest browser shell order-entry panel for selecting a robot and queueing supported high-level orders, refresh autosave and shell state after each action, and surface validation feedback in the existing UI status patterns while preserving current controls.

title: Implement Cloudflare deployment config
description: Add root Wrangler static-assets config, minimal Cloudflare Terraform under infra/terraform, and repo usage scripts/docs for building, Wrangler preview/deploy, and Terraform plan/apply. Validate the web build and a lightweight Wrangler config check if feasible.

title: Implement Remote Ops packets and save payloads
description: Add structured AI-readable packet generation, define the canonical save payload for Remote Ops, add save serialization helpers, and keep replay scaffolding small and deterministic.
notes: Resolved with src/saveCodecs.lib.sigil deriving json for µSaveFile and µReplayLog, while src/types.lib.sigil stays type-only. src/saveApi.lib.sigil now builds canonical payloads, and save/replay codec tests pass under sigil test.

title: Implement Remote Ops simulation loop
description: Create the first deterministic order-processing and interruption loop for Remote Ops. The simulation should advance queued high-level robot orders in atomic steps, update mission metrics, emit event-log entries, and stop on meaningful interrupts rather than forcing one-tile-at-a-time input.

title: Generate first HelixGrid facility slice
description: Implement the first semi-procedural HelixGrid facility generator. The generator should produce the vertical-slice room graph, key room placement, basic tile/security/objective placement, and deterministic variation so the simulation can stop depending on one fully fixed map.

title: Define Remote Ops domain model
description: Establish the deterministic Sigil domain model for Remote Ops. Create the initial canonical types and module surfaces for missions, facilities, robots, parts, objectives, orders, interrupts, meters, and save-friendly state so later simulation and UI work can build on a stable core.

title: Bootstrap Remote Ops foundation
description: Create the initial Sigil project scaffold and the browser shell foundation for Remote Ops. This includes a neutral Sigil root, web app skeleton, generated TypeScript handoff path, and the initial project structure for the vertical slice.
